Verbal: nothing says she is gagged or silenced, so V is met. Material: a spellcasting focus can replace a material component that has no cost. The material-component entry adds that the hand holding a focus 'can be the same hand that he or she uses to perform somatic components.' The conclusion turns on the phrases 'free use of at least one hand' and 'a hand free ... to hold a spellcasting focus,' and the text allows another reading. Reading 1: the shield hand holds the focus (the emblem), and the same-hand clause lets it make the gestures, so the answer is yes.
